title: Tim Burchett on the high rate of researchers disappearing

tellings.quote: He told the Daily Mail that the numbers seem very high in these certain areas of research.

plain: Tim Burchett, a member of the US Congress, told the British newspaper the Daily Mail that the number of researchers going missing in certain fields of research seems very high. Michels passes on the remark in an episode about missing American scientists. He uses it to show that even a lawmaker thinks the pattern looks troubling.
